_help: Per-game plan overrides, keyed by file name, file stem or slug. Any key of runner.py's DEFAULT_PLAN (boot_wait, input_time, input_gap, buttons, press_ms, settle, mid_shot, hard_limit), or steps: [[seconds, action, args...]] (shot <name> | tap <btn> [ms] | down <btn>... | up <btn>... | release), extra_steps: [...], skip: <reason>. Example: "halo-2-u-en-ja-fr-de-es-it-zh-ko": {"boot_wait": 15, "buttons": ["start", "a", "a"]}

burnout-3-takedown-u._why: 'Would you like to save your profile?' and 'Autosave will be disabled. Are you sure?' both default to NO, so Start/A loop between them (from about 20 s). Up then A chooses YES; a second try at 59 s in case the prompts came late.

conker-live-reloaded-u-en-ja-fr-de-es-it._why: A on the top menu picks 'Xbox Live & Co' (multiplayer), which leads to a profile keyboard Start/A can't leave. Left first moves to a single-player 'Game' slot.

deus-ex-invisible-war-u._why: The character setup screen (from about 30 s) starts on Difficulty; 'done' is three downs away, then A and A for 'Start Game?'. A second try at 59 s in case the screen came late.

need-for-speed-most-wanted-u._why: 'Do you want to create a new alias?' defaults to No, so Start/A loop between it and the career main menu. Down in the cycle picks Yes; the name keyboard's Done is Start, and the career starts.

midnight-club-3-dub-edition-u._why: In the garage (from about 60 s), A on Exit Garage opens 'Exit the garage?', which defaults to NO. Up then A, just after the default A that opens it (default A presses fall at 63, 68, 73... s), picks YES and starts the first race. Up in the button cycle instead wanders into the Options menus.

outrun-2006-coast-2-coast-u-en-fr-de-es-._why: The licence name keyboard (from about 25 s) starts on '1', A only types and Start doesn't finish it. Left wraps to the right-hand column, down x4 reaches Done; on the licence card, down x3 reaches DONE. Then the main menu's Single Player leads to a race.

prince-of-persia-the-sands-of-time-u-en-._why: From about 30 s a balcony scene that the in-game judge takes for gameplay, though Start and A change nothing. No judge: plain Start/A for the full 300 s, to see whether it ever moves on (issue #96).

soulcalibur-ii-u._why: 'Autosave will be disabled ... Continue anyway?' (from about 30 s) defaults to No. Left then A picks Yes; a second try 20 s later.

prince-of-persia-the-two-thrones-u-en-fr._why: 'Create New Profile' keyboard (from about 40 s): A types letters, Start does nothing; CREATE is six rows below the starting focus and the default name is already there. Down x6 then A at 50 s. No unstick presses: B would leave the keyboard.

prince-of-persia-warrior-within-u-en-fr-._why: 'Create New Profile' keyboard (from about 40 s): A types letters, Start does nothing; CREATE is six rows below the starting focus and the default name is already there. Down x6 then A at 50 s. No unstick presses: B would leave the keyboard.

club-football-aston-villa-uk._why: Player-creation dialog (from about 30 s): right x3 to Skip, then A. Controller Select (up by 70 s) toggles a 'No human teams selected' alert on every Start/A, and only the club's side (home or away by fixture) takes controller 1. B (ignored under the alert, back to Play Match otherwise) then A gives a clean screen; right, A, A sets the away side and its config, and up, A picks Play Match (the Pre-Match menu starts on Formation and Tactics, the line-up screen). If the club is home those A's only toggle the alert, so B, A resyncs and left, A, A, up, A does it from the home side.

tom-clancy-s-ghost-recon-u._why: From about 43 s, A on the dossier name entry opens 'overwrite the saved game?' (NO default) and Start dismisses it, so the run loops. YES only goes back to the Dossier screen, where Start/A re-enter SELECT DOSSIER, and on the main menu Start/A just open and close the Start menu. Right+A picks YES, down down A picks the Dossier ACCEPT, then A's go Campaign > New Campaign > Proceed > Briefing Proceed > Auto Assign > GO into the mission.

tony-hawk-s-underground-u._why: Story mode opens in Create-a-Skater, and Start/A go Create Options > Edit Skater > Pre-made list, where A just re-picks a skater (stuck from about 40 s). B B B backs out to Create Options (B does nothing there), down down selects DONE (DESIGN DECK is skipped), and A starts the story cutscene, which the default Start/A skip into gameplay.

tom-clancy-s-ghost-recon-2-u-en-fr-de-es._why: A on Single Player gives a 'create a profile' dialog, then A the Name Profile wheel, but the next default press is Start, which opens the START MENU, and A there picks Main Menu, so the run loops back to the main menu. Only A presses are needed: ACCEPT (default name PROFILE) > Activate > Single Player > Campaign > ACCEPT > Normal > Equipment > the intro cinematic > gameplay. An A every 2 s works from any point in the loop; it runs to the end, as the main menu can take until about 110 s.

ssx-on-tour-u._why: 'Do you want to enable the autosave feature?' and 'Are you sure you want to continue without autosave?' both default to No and alternate with every A (from about 28 s). Down+A picks Yes on whichever is up; both lead to the main menu and The Tour's Create New profile keyboard, where Start (ENTER) on an empty name gives 'Invalid Profile Name'. Right, down (ESC > 1 > Q), A types Q, Start enters it; the default presses then go through character creation into the first race.

tom-clancy-s-splinter-cell-u-en-fr._why: Profile Name keyboard (up by 30 s): A only types and Start does nothing; B leaves it for Profile Settings with NAME selected and the name back to SAM. Up wraps to SAVE, A saves, and Start on the Profiles list starts the training mission.

thief-deadly-shadows-u._why: Brightness screen (up by 30 s) starts on DEFAULTS; right then A picks OK. The Enter Mission screen that follows starts on BRIEFING, where Start/A do nothing; START is four downs away (no wrap), then A, and the default A dismisses the training notice.

toca-race-driver-2-u._why: Select Profile: A on Load opens an empty slot list (Back selected) and Start on Back returns, so the cycle loops. Just after the default Start at 35.5 (menu up): down to New, A, up to slot 3, A, A on Done, then Options/Begin leads to the first race.

star-wars-republic-commando-u._why: Profile-name keyboard starts on OK with an empty name: A gives 'WARNING: a profile name must be at least one letter', Start returns to the keyboard. Just after the default Start at 35.5: up to T, A types it, down to OK, A; the main menu's New Game follows.

star-wars-battlefront-u._why: On Select Character (from about 60 s) every Start opens the Game Paused menu and the next A only resumes, so the character is never picked. A instead of the Start at 75.5 gives two A presses in a row and the droid spawns; a second try at 95.5 is only a jump if already in game.

fifa-street-u._why: Pick Sides (from about 50 s): the default Start activates controller 1 in the middle, but nothing moves it to a side, and the unstick B then backs out to the main menu. Right held 500 ms puts it on AWAY, A confirms 'No profile', A again goes to Select Team; the default presses start the match.

mtx-mototrax-u._why: Edit Rider (from about 30 s) loops with the name keyboard: A on 'rider name' opens the keyboard, Start closes it. Just after a default Start the Edit Rider list is up: down x3 reaches 'done', then A. The window drops the default A at 38.0 that would reopen the keyboard.

major-league-baseball-2k5-u._why: 'You are about to overwrite "Profile1" ... Continue?' (from about 50 s) has No on top, selected. Down then A picks Yes and saves, but the Save Profile screen behind it reopens the prompt on the next A, so B then leaves Save Profile.

major-league-baseball-2k5-world-series-e._why: 'You are about to overwrite "Profile1" ... Continue?' (from about 50 s) has No on top, selected. Down then A picks Yes and saves, but the Save Profile screen behind it reopens the prompt on the next A, so B then leaves Save Profile.

freestyle-street-soccer-u._why: Two save prompts (from about 30 s) default to No: left then A picks Yes. Team select (from about 45 s) leaves controller 1 in the middle: left puts it on Home Team, A, A confirm it and the kits; tried again at 66 s.

king-of-fighters-2003-the-u-en-ja._why: The order-select screen (from about 45 s) assigns each fighter to X, Y or B; Start/A do nothing there. X, Y, B set the order.

king-of-fighters-the-neowave-u-en-ja-fr-._why: The order-select screen (from about 45 s) assigns each fighter to X, Y or B; Start/A do nothing there. X, Y, B set the order.

fifa-street-2-u-en-es._why: Pick Sides (from about 45 s) opens with controller 1 on HOME, but each default Start toggles it off/on, and it comes back on in the middle where A does nothing. Left, A continues from HOME or the middle; Start, left, A covers the off state (on Select Team, Start does nothing and left only changes the home team). The default A's pick the teams.

crash-tag-team-racing-u._why: On Single Player, 'Do you want to enter the park?' (from about 45 s) defaults to NO, and the default Start/A open and close it in turn (which one opens it depends on timing). Right then A, twice: from the menu the first right does nothing and A opens the prompt; from the prompt, right picks YES and A enters.

nba-inside-drive-2004-u._why: The Controllers screen (from about 47 s) leaves controller 1 in the middle, and A answers Yes to 'CPU-only game?', so the match is CPU vs CPU. Right held 400 ms (three times, as the screen's arrival varies) puts it on Home, then A.

amped-freestyle-snowboarding-u._why: Skill Select (from about 30 s) needs all 5 skill points spent before A continues ('Use all available skill points to continue'). Right x5 on Spin spends them, then A.

bass-pro-shops-trophy-bass-2007-u._why: Player Setup (from about 30 s) has Create on Y; Start/A do nothing there. Y creates the player.

blazing-angels-squadrons-of-wwii-u-en-fr._why: Profiles ('No available profile', from about 30 s) only offers Y (new); Start/A do nothing there. Y starts a new profile.

burnout-revenge-u._why: 'There are no profiles to load' (from about 30 s, A OK) never passes with A. Try B, twice in case the first lands before the box is ready.

need-for-speed-most-wanted-black-edition._why: Same as Most Wanted: 'Do you want to create a new alias?' defaults to No, so Start/A loop between it and the career main menu. Down in the cycle picks Yes; the name keyboard's Done is Start, and the career starts.

need-for-speed-carbon-u._why: As in Most Wanted, 'Do you want to create a new alias?' (from about 30 s) defaults to No, so Start/A loop between it and Career > START CAREER. Down in the cycle picks Yes.

nba-street-vol-2-usa._why: User Setup (from about 45 s) leaves player 1's controller between AWAY (up) and HOME (down), so Start/A don't go on. Up held 400 ms picks AWAY, then A.

nba-street-vol-2-europe._why: User Setup (from about 45 s) leaves player 1's controller between AWAY (up) and HOME (down), so Start/A don't go on. Up held 400 ms picks AWAY, then A.

nhl-06-u._why: Choose Teams (from about 30 s) leaves the controller icons in the middle: Start opens 'the game will be entirely computer controlled. Is this what you want?' Just after a default A it is on Choose Teams: right held 500 ms sides controller 1 with the home team, then Start.

nhl-07-u._why: Choose Teams (from about 30 s) leaves the controller icons in the middle: Start opens 'the game will be entirely computer controlled. Is this what you want?' nhl-2005-u._why: Choose Teams (from about 30 s) with the controller icons in the middle; A toggles 'the game will be entirely computer controlled' (Cancel selected). Right held 500 ms then A, twice: if the prompt was up, the first A cancels it and the second pair sides controller 1 and goes on.

nhl-2003-u._why: Game Setup (from about 30 s) has all four controllers in the middle, so Start (Advance) does nothing. Right held 500 ms puts controller 1 on Home, then Start.

nhl-hitz-2002-u._why: The Away/Home controller screen (from about 30 s) has the controllers in the middle column. Right held 500 ms moves controller 1 to Home, then A.

nhl-hitz-2003-u._why: Choose Teams (from about 30 s) has USER1-4 in the middle row between the Away team (above) and Home team (below). Up held 500 ms moves USER1 to Away, then A.

nhl-hitz-pro-u._why: Select Teams (from about 30 s) has USER1-4 in the middle between Away and Home, so Accept does nothing. Right held 500 ms moves USER1 to Home, then A.

outlaw-golf-u._why: The Load screen (from about 30 s, Hard Disk selected) ignores A, as there is nothing to load. B (Back) leaves it; a second B 20 s later in case the first came too early.

nba-2k2-u._why: Main menu ring (up by about 45 s) has no mode highlighted, so Start/A pick nothing. D-pad down highlights Quickstart, A starts a game with random teams, and A taps skip the player intros to tip-off. In game Start pauses and A then opens Stats, so the default presses are dropped from 54 s.

nfl-2k2-u._why: Untested copy of the NBA 2K2 override (same 2K main-menu ring, up by about 45 s with nothing highlighted): down, then A, with A taps to the kickoff and the default presses dropped (Start pauses in game).

nba-ballers-phenom-u._why: Quick Pick controller screen (up from about 55 s to the unstick B at 93 s) has all controllers in the middle column, so A does nothing. A d-pad left tap moves controller 1 to team 1 and A accepts. The default A presses then pick players and a crib and start the game.

nba-ballers-phenom-u-beta._why: Quick Pick controller screen (up from about 55 s to the unstick B at 93 s) has all controllers in the middle column, so A does nothing. mvp-baseball-2005-u._why: User Profiles (from about 45 s): Start/A toggle between it and the 'No profile... Proceed' popup. B on the popup does nothing, and B on User Profiles goes to the Main Menu. B, A, B ends on the Main Menu from either screen. A only, because in game Start pauses and A then opens Replay.

mad-dash-racing-u._why: Sign Up name grid (from about 30 s). Up then left wraps the cursor from A to OK and A accepts. Initials are needed too: down and A enter the grid, down then A types G, up then A is OK. Down to Save To and A saves. On the Adventure screen, down then A picks the first empty story save, then the default presses get to the race.

outlaw-tennis-u._why: Quick Play Player Setup ('Assign controllers', from about 30 s) has P1 in the middle of the court, so Start/A don't go on. Left held 400 ms puts P1 on a side, then A.

outlaw-volleyball-u._why: Choose Controllers ('Pick teams and positions', from about 30 s) has P1 above the middle of the court, so Start/A don't go on and the unstick B backs out. Left held 400 ms puts P1 on a team, then Start.

arx-fatalis-u-beta-1._why: The character sheet (up by about 70 s) wants all attribute points spent before Start (Go!); A only adds points to Strength. Y (Quick generate) spends them, then Start.

big-bumpin-u._why: Single Player (a 2x2 grid, from about 50 s) has CHARACTERS selected; A opens Select Character and comes back, so Start/A loop. Up, left, A picks RIDES; done twice in case the first lands on Select Character (where it picks a character and returns).

battlefield-2-modern-combat-u._why: The Campaign Name keyboard (up by about 70 s) has the cursor on A, so A only types. Down to the J row, right x10 to ENTER at its end, then A.

187-ride-or-die-u-en-fr-de-es-it._why: The Player Profile keyboard (from about 50 s) only types with A; its legend gives Y for 'Validate text'. Y accepts the name.

50-cent-bulletproof-u._why: The profile-name keyboard (from about 50 s) has the cursor on 'a', so A only types. Up (to '1') then left reaches Done at the head of the left column, then A.

american-chopper-u._why: 'Enter your name' (from about 50 s) has the cursor on 'a', so A only types. Down x3 to the bottom row (Caps Lock), right x2 to Done, then A.

aquaman-battle-for-atlantis-u._why: The setup screen (Character / Difficulty / Start, from about 50 s) has Character selected, which A doesn't leave. Down x2 to START, then A.

arctic-thunder-u._why: Player Select (from about 30 s) has player 1 joined but DONE, below the players, is never selected. Down to DONE, then A.

call-of-duty-finest-hour-u._why: Profiles (from about 45 s) has four <Empty> slots; A (Accept) does nothing on an empty slot and B goes back to the title. X (New) creates a profile; Start then tries to accept the default name (not confirmed by hand).

bloodrayne-u._why: 'Choose control scheme' (from about 50 s) lists Control style / Look up/down style / Start Game with Control style selected; A only opens and closes its explanation page. Down x2, A picks Start Game; done twice so it also works if the explanation page was up (where A returns to the list).

bruce-lee-quest-of-the-dragon-u._why: The pre-level menu (Player Info / Purchase Moves / Continue) has Player Info selected, and A opens a page only B closes (up at 70 s). B, down x2 to Continue, then A.

cabela-s-big-game-hunter-2005-adventures._why: A on the main menu's LOAD PROFILE gives 'No saved profiles' (from about 30 s), where A does nothing. B back to the main menu, down to CREATE PROFILE, then A.
